messages:
elena: Quick sync w/ EdgeFlow + Acme POC — they require an air-gapped on-prem deployment, HSM-backed key storage, SCIM + SSO (SAML), and per-tenant entitlements. Partner wants a short runbook and a filled security questionnaire by EOD Tue. Can we list blockers + owners? Next demo Wed.
sam_partner: Partner note: infra insists on no public egress from runtime. They want model artifacts pulled and served locally. Also need per-tenant rate limits and entitlements mapped to their billing ids.
mike: Clarifying Qs: do we need the full Redwood Private package for this POC or a Dedicated-reserved pool in their VPC? HSM vendor specifics — we have AWS KMS guides and HashiCorp PKCS11 notes but no vendor certification docs for Thales/Yubikey-style HSMs.
lara: Security checklist items I'll need to answer questionnaire: 1) evidence no data exfil possible from inference runtime, 2) HSM key import/export policy and key lifecycle, 3) audit log retention and format, 4) required ports and network diagram for SOC review, 5) proof of encryption-in-transit for model blobs. I can draft, but need network CIDRs + SSO metadata.
mike: Proposed minimal runbook snippet (for engineering/onsite):

```
step 1: provision private control plane endpoint in customer's VPC (airgap gateway)
step 2: deploy redwood-private runtime on air-gapped nodes (k8s static manifests)
step 3: import model tarball via secure offline transfer (sftp over isolated network or USB with signed checksum)
step 4: configure HSM with key_id=acme-poc-key and mount via PKCS11 module
step 5: configure telemetry sink to the partner proxy (10.10.0.5:443) with client cert auth
```

We will need on-site access or an OOB mechanism to load model artifacts. Also need engineering sign-off for PKCS11 vendor support.
elena: Pricing ask from partner: can we provide a near-term quote for a 3-month POC (2 GPUs dedicated, offline model hosting) + optional HSM integration? Sales needs a ballpark by tomorrow.
mike: Ballpark numbers: ~$28k/month for 2x A10-equivalent dedicated nodes + one-time private onboarding fee ~$12k. HSM integration eng time estimate ~60h (eng rate + potential vendor cert). I'll formalize with finance.
lara: Confirm SLA note — I believe private/offline POCs have a lower infra SLA (we default to 99.5%). Ops, please confirm if we can commit 99.9% for this setup.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: New ticket created: POC-1207 (private-airgap-acme). Assigned: mike, lara, elena. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/POC-1207
sam_partner: Telemetry ask from partner: they can accept sampled metrics only and require no raw prompt retention. Requested sample rate 0.1% and anonymization of prompt tokens.
mike: We support sampling + payload strip. Example runtime config:

```
telemetry:
  enabled: true
  sampling_rate: 0.001
  strip_payloads: true
  proxy: https://proxy.acme.internal:8443
```

We'll add a pre-upload scrub step to the runbook to enforce token redaction.
lara: For the security questionnaire I'll need: SSO metadata (entityID, cert), SCIM endpoint details, network CIDRs, list of ports (egress allowed to proxy), and the signed partner NDA. Send them to me and I'll mark high-risk items.
elena: Action items summary:
- mike: draft full runbook + HSM checklist (EOD Mon)
- lara: draft security questionnaire answers + list of required docs (EOD Tue)
- elena: provide pricing ballpark to partner + sales handoff (Mon noon)
- sam_partner: confirm offline artifact transfer method and provide proxy contact/cert info
I'll schedule a 30m sync Tue 10am PT. :calendar:
mike: noted. I'll also prepare a small PKCS11 verification script and a short on-site checklist for the infra lead.
sam_partner: Thanks all — looping in Acme infra lead jess (they'll DM certs). We'll aim to confirm artifact transfer method today.
